title: MemDoctor: Stage-wise Error Attribution and Repair for MLLM Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.21019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now assist users across sessions of images and text, carried by an external memory of what was said and shown. When such an assistant answers wrongly, the failure usually began earlier, in how a record was written, updated or retrieved, and the answer alone does not say where. We formalize multimodal memory as four stages, Write, Update, Retrieve and Answer, and define nine error types across them. A stage-resolved analysis on Mem-Gallery traces most failures to a source stage, and most of those lie before the answer. Injecting known errors against fact-preserving control edits, we then follow each tainted record downstream. Early errors survive to the answer as apparent evidence, and hurt most when no other record holds the fact. translated_title: MemDoctor：面向多模态大语言模型智能体记忆的分阶段错误归因与修复
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型现在能够跨会话地协助用户处理图像和文本，其依托于一个记录用户所言和所示内容的外部记忆。当这样的助手给出错误回答时，失败往往在更早阶段就已发生——即记录被写入、更新或检索的方式，而仅凭答案本身无法判断问题出在哪里。我们将多模态记忆形式化为四个阶段：写入、更新、检索和回答，并在这四个阶段中定义了九种错误类型。基于 Mem-Gallery 的分阶段解析分析将大多数失败追溯到某个源头阶段，且其中大多数发生在回答阶段之前。通过注入已知错误并与保持事实不变的对照编辑进行比较，我们随后追踪每条被污染记录在下游的影响。早期错误会以“表面证据”的形式存活到最终答案，且在没有其他记录持有该事实时危害最大。因此，一种信任所引用证据的诊断方式会责怪错误显现的阶段，而非错误产生的阶段。我们提出 MemDoctor，其中多模态大语言模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 MemDoctor 框架，将多模态智能体记忆形式化为写入、更新、检索、回答四个阶段并定义九种错误类型，通过追踪被污染记录的下游传播，将错误归因于其产生的源头阶段而非错误显现的阶段，从而实现记忆错误的诊断与修复。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MemDoctor, a framework that formalizes MLLM agent memory into four stages (Write, Update, Retrieve, Answer) with nine defined error types, and traces tainted records downstream to attribute errors to their source stage rather than where they surface, enabling diagnosis and repair of memory failures.
